title: Lead Window of the Replacing HomeFlood Policy — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
### Lead window (NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own))

For a request signed under Replaced by Private Flood because a Tidemark HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy recorded as replacing this policy took effect, the lead window is measured from the replacing policy's application date to its effective date:

- **30 days** when the replacing policy was written on the basis that it replaces an NFIP policy with no gap (the HomeFlood policy's waiting-period basis is NFIP replacement);
- **20 days** when it was written on the standard waiting basis;
- **no days** otherwise.

When the replacing policy's application came longer before its effective date than the window allows, the request may be dated no earlier than the signing date.

| HomeFlood waiting-period basis | Days from application to effective date | Within |
|---|---|---|
| NFIP replacement | 30 or fewer | Yes |
| NFIP replacement | 31 or more | No |
| Standard | 20 or fewer | Yes |
| Standard | 21 or more | No |
| Any other, or no application date on record | — | No |
